notes:
- New mode: TANK TRANSPORT. Escort a slow tank through checkpoints to the end; whoever controls the area around it moves it forward or pushes it back. The tank flattens walls in its way and shells defenders.
- Bot difficulty is now Recruit, Private, Lieutenant and Commander. Higher ranks hear footsteps, share sightings, fall back to cover, flank, spread across objectives and aim better.
- Killstreaks: choose any 3 of 13, including Signal Jammer, Supply Drop, Precision Strike, Hunter Drone, Sentry Turret, Spectre Sweep, Thunder Gunship, EMP Burst and Thunderclap. Bomber Run, Precision Strike and Cluster Barrage are aimed on a tactical map.
- Perks: 3 slots and 18 perks, including Cold Front, Shield Mask, Silent Step, Hunter's Sense, Sapper, Double Down, Pathfinder, Restock, Payback, Head Start and High Alert.
- Gunsmith: 38 new attachments, such as Monolith and Compact suppressors, Full Choke, Fluted and Integral barrels, Thermal Hybrid, LPVO, Canted, 4x Prism, Grip-Pod, Combat Flashlight, Slug, Incendiary and Subsonic rounds.
- Change your loadout from the death screen.
- Maps: grass, bushes, better trees and rocks, shell craters (explosions leave new ones), barbed-wire lines, tank wrecks, Humvees, trucks, parked jets and cargo planes, and window, ledge and rooftop detail on buildings.
- Quieter, softer footsteps with their own volume slider.
